items.title: Pay piano service invoice
items.quote: Wir bitten Sie, die Rechnung binnen 20 Tagen ab Rechnungsdatum zu bezahlen.
items.computation: Period 'binnen 20 Tagen ab Rechnungsdatum' runs from the invoice date 19.11.2026. Under § 187(1) BGB, since the period starts from an event (the invoice date), that day itself is not counted; counting begins on 20.11.2026. Adding 20 days from 19.11.2026: Nov has 30 days, so 11 days remain in November (20.11.–30.11.) and the remaining 9 days fall in December, landing on 09.12.2026. Checked weekday: 09.12.2026 is a Wednesday (24.11.2026 is Tuesday, so 24.11 Tue → 09.12 is 15 days later → Wed), so no weekend/holiday shift under § 193 BGB is needed.

warnings: The customer address block shows an unexplained stray number '4471' between the street line and the postal code/city line ('Ackerstraße 26   4471' / '48143 Mustermünster'); this looks like a formatting artifact and should be checked but does not appear to be a scam indicator.
This is a private craftsman's invoice with no legal-remedy instructions (Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung), which is normal for such invoices; it is not a tax or administrative decision.
